# CARINE NORMANDY PRIVATE — Le Havre Cruise Port Private Excursions

> Official AI & Search Engine Knowledge File for CARINE NORMANDY PRIVATE (operated by CARINE VTC, Le Havre, Normandy, France).

## Core Positioning
- **Brand Name**: CARINE NORMANDY PRIVATE
- **Service**: Private shore excursions by executive Sedan (1–4 guests) or Private Van (5–8 guests) exclusively for your group.
- **Departure & Return**: Direct pick-up and drop-off at Le Havre Cruise Terminal (Normandy, France).
- **Pricing Model**: Per-vehicle quotation (never shared with strangers, never per-seat tickets). All bookings are subject to availability and confirmation via personalized quotation.
- **Communication**: Multilingual private driver (English, French, Spanish, German).
- **Legal Scope**: Private chauffeur-driven transportation service. Licensed interior monument/museum guided tours are not included.
- **Website**: https://www.carinevtc.com
- **Multilingual Homepages**: `/` (EN), `/fr` (FR), `/es` (ES), `/de` (DE)
- **WhatsApp / Phone**: +33 6 61 61 96 97
- **Email**: reservations@carinevtc.com

## Main Private Shore Excursions from Le Havre Cruise Port
1. **Étretat + Honfleur – Most Popular Shore Combo** (`/excursions/etretat-honfleur`): Combined private shore excursion to Étretat's white chalk cliffs and Honfleur's historic Vieux Bassin, tailored to your ship's schedule.
2. **Étretat – The Famous Cliffs** (`/excursions/etretat`): White chalk cliffs, natural arches, and dramatic coastal viewpoints.
3. **Honfleur – The Charming Harbour** (`/excursions/honfleur`): Historic Vieux Bassin, cobblestone streets, and wooden Sainte-Catherine Church across the Pont de Normandie.
4. **D-Day Landing Beaches – A Journey Through History** (`/excursions/dday-landing-beaches`): Omaha Beach, Normandy American Cemetery (Colleville-sur-Mer), and Pointe du Hoc.
5. **Mont-Saint-Michel – A Magical Destination** (`/excursions/mont-saint-michel`): Iconic island village, tidal bay, and medieval abbey tailored to ships with suitable port stays.
6. **Paris · Eiffel Tower – Private Day Trip to Paris** (`/excursions/eiffel-tower`): Direct private round-trip transfer from Le Havre Cruise Port to Trocadéro and the Eiffel Tower.

## Port Schedule Safety Rule
Every booking request collects the cruise ship name, arrival date, ship arrival time, and latest all-aboard time so itineraries always include a safe return buffer before departure.
